entries.text: Runs routed through the greybeam gateway now fail before any work when they would generate or load data inline, or run TPC-H/TPC-DS maintenance, because the CDC-fed replica would be empty or stale; --allow-greybeam-inline-load plus BENCHBOX_I_UNDERSTAND_GREYBEAM_LOAD=1 overrides the load check (invalid data), and an implied maintenance phase is skipped with a warning. Includes a quiescence runbook in the Snowflake platform docs.
details: Query-only runs also refuse implicit reload/recreation of a missing, empty, or incompatible replica and fail before database management when force-recreate is requested.
